dataSource: City of Miami building permits since 2014 (ArcGIS open data), queried live
notes: Pulled live from the City of Miami's own ArcGIS open data feed on every search, not a static extract — coverage reflects whatever the city has published as of your search.
Matched by house number plus the first word of the street name; results may occasionally include unrelated records that happen to share both.

Description and status currently show the same underlying status text (e.g. "Final", "Expired", "Revoked") rather than a separate work description — a limitation of the source dataset's field layout, not a data-quality issue.
Permit type shows the property's use classification (e.g. "Commercial") rather than a specific permit type; permit number is not reliably populated in this dataset.
summary: Miami is covered by a live query against the City of Miami's public building-permits dataset, matched by address as you search.
